Generates a patch for a vulnerability finding using the LLM fix agent,
with interactive review and apply.

Target must be a finding UUID (or unambiguous prefix) from a previous 'cm find' session.

Examples:
  cm fix abc123-def456               # Fix finding by full UUID
  cm fix 8293b                       # Fix finding by UUID prefix
  cm fix 8293b -c "Focus on the auth bypass path"  # Add extra context
  cm fix 9864 --no-cache             # Force fresh run, ignore cache

Usage:
  cm fix [command]
Flags:
  -c, --context <text>        Additional context to guide the fix agent
      --export <session-id>   Export patch from a session ID
  -h, --help                  help for fix
      --model string          LLM model to use (default "cm-default-model")
      --no-cache              Bypass cached patches, always run a fresh fix session
      --unrestricted          Disable filesystem sandbox (allow agent to access any path)
  -y, --yes                   Skip all confirmation prompts (commands and file writes)

Use "cm fix [command] --help" for more information about a command.
